observations.code_quote: Per-company tables (company profile, quote, company news, basic financials, recommendation trends, earnings surprises, stock candles, as-reported financials, SEC filings, insider transactions) are synced for each ticker you list in **Symbols**. Market-wide tables (stock symbols, market news, IPO calendar, earnings calendar, countries) sync without any symbols.
